additions.name: Digital Realty HKG11 (Kin Chuen) — existing data-centre operations

status.summary: Digital Realty's own blog of 13 October 2026 states that Digital Realty operates two data centres in Hong Kong and that HKG11, at 11 Kin Chuen Street, Kwai Chung, spans 228,000 sq ft (21,182 m²) across 12 storeys with eight dedicated data-hall floors; it calls HKG11 its second Hong Kong data centre and lists its current certifications. This establishes an operating colocation data centre on that date. It gives no MW capacity, occupancy or opening date.

locator.precision: Centroid of the 2,781 m2 Kwai Chung Town Lot No. 495, the only lot containing the official 11 Kin Chuen Street address point. It is a lot-level marker, not a surveyed building outline, entrance or data-hall location.
locator.identity_review: Digital Realty's facility page gives HKG11 at '11 Kin Chuen, Kwai Chung', its 13 October 2026 blog at '11 Kin Chuen Street, Kwai Chung', and its 1 July 2020 release names the purpose-built Kwai Chung building 'Digital Realty Kin Chuen (HKG11)'. The official Address Lookup Service resolves 11 Kin Chuen Street (no building name; address record created 18 May 2020) to HK1980 E 831342 N 825687, and a CSDI point-intersection query returns exactly one lot there, LotCSUID 553000495 = Kwai Chung Town Lot No. 495; the address point is 4.2 m from the lot centroid. Digital Realty's own map marker for HKG11 falls on unleased land about 11 m outside the lot and is not used. The Geodetic Survey transformation service reproduces the transformed centroid to under 1e-7 degrees.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The lot layer states no positional tolerance; the 1 m datum-operation accuracy is not a boundary accuracy. The point lies inside a lot about 56 m by 93 m.

additions.successor_review: Digital Realty's English sitemap (captured 26 October 2026, local digitalrealty-en-sitemap.xml) lists no Hong Kong press release, facility change or closure after the 13 October blog; the newest Hong Kong items are this blog and the Korean translation of it. Digital Realty's third-quarter 2026 results are scheduled for 29 October 2026 (local dlr-q3-2026-schedule.html) and had not been released at capture. status.summary: On 14 September 2026 Boda Data said in its own newsroom that its Langfang No. 2 intelligent computing base serves leading Internet enterprises with customised services, alongside its other Langfang projects. This present-tense operator statement confirms that the base was operating on 14 September 2026. Phase 2 was still in its last pre-production validation round on 9 October 2026, so the operating service is that of Phase 1. The statement gives no opening day, capacity in use or building, and none is asserted.

status_updates.identity_review: Same project as the existing record 'Boda Langfang No. 2 Phase 1' (project 760bbd20-e137-5015-9956-1d5b17000e18 on site vcc-site-358391d4dd9bae1018fd, operational as of 21 July 2026 from Boda's WAIC item, xwzx/903). Boda's 14 September item names the same Langfang No. 2 intelligent computing base (博大数据廊坊二号智算基地), operated by the same company, and describes the same customer group (leading Internet enterprises) as the 21 July item. The operator's campus directory (jjjdq.html, re-captured 26 October 2026 with the same SHA-256, 79951adf..., as the baseline locator capture) still lists a single Langfang No. 2 base in Anci District. The statement is base-level. It is assigned to Phase 1 only because the base's other project, Phase 2 (project 41f90b54), was still in pre-production functional validation on 9 October 2026 (Hebei Daily on-site report in the existing record), with operation forecast for year end. The Langfang No. 1 base named in the same passage is a different facility built for JD.com; it is not this site and is not added. The locator, scope, capacity and roles are unchanged.
status_updates.successor_review: Strictly newer than the existing 21 July 2026 observation. Re-checked on 26 October 2026: Boda's newsroom list (xwzx.html and xwzx-2.html, items 886 to 928) has no later item that names the Langfang No. 2 base. The 24 September item (xwzx/925) describes Langfang only generically. The 20 October item (xwzx/926) concerns the Philippines. The Hebei Daily report of 12 October 2026 (republished by the Hebei Cyberspace Administration) quotes the project manager saying that Phase 1 was put into use in October 2025 and that Phase 2 would complete testing and acceptance at the end of October and enter production at year end; those Phase 2 events are forecasts and belong to the separate Phase 2 record. No pause, closure or reduction of Phase 1 was found. Keep Phase 1 operational as of 14 September 2026.
